title: Pacing: one point at a time

steps.say: Wrap the list in ::: {.incremental} and it arrives one point at a time. The first click shows only the first point.
The next click brings the next point. You talk about one number while the room looks at that one number.
Three spaced dots, . . ., pause anything, not just a list: the closing line waits for its own click.

title: "Unemployment in the regions"
subtitle: "Quarterly briefing · synthetic data"
format: revealjs
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
rates <- read_csv("unemployment.csv")
kingdom <- rates |> filter(region == "Kingdom")
jazan <- rates |> filter(region == "Jazan")
change <- rates |>
  filter(region != "Kingdom") |>
  group_by(region) |>
  summarise(change = last(rate) - first(rate))
up <- change |> filter(change > 0) |> pull(region)
```

## Unemployment is falling

::: {.incremental}
- Down in `r sum(change$change < 0)` of `r nrow(change)` regions since 2022
- It rose only in `r up`
:::

. . .
